title: Dove
description:
White dove ek shant, komal aur sundar pakshi hota hai jo shanti aur prem ka prateek mana jata hai. Iska sharir poori tarah safed pankhon se dhaka hota hai, jo dhoop mein chamakte hue bahut khoobsurat lagte hain. Iski aankhen aam taur par laal ya kaali hoti hain aur chonch halka gulabi ya narangi rang ki hoti hai.
White dove ka swabhav bahut hi shaant aur milansar hota hai. Ye zyada tar jodon (pairs) mein rehta hai aur apne saathi ke prati wafadar mana jata hai. Isliye ise prem aur wafadari ka symbol bhi kaha jata hai.
Yeh pakshi beej, dana aur chhote anaj khata hai. White dove ko aksar shaadi, shanti sammelan aur dharmik karyakramon mein udte hue dekha jata hai, jahan yeh shanti ka sandesh deta hai.
White dove ka sambandh Bible ki kahaniyon aur prachin sabhyataon se bhi joda jata hai, jahan ise umeed aur nayi shuruaat ka prateek mana gaya hai.
Agar aap chahein to main white dove ki 60 second ki mahiti ya cinematic video prompt bhi bana sakta hoon.
